280747399.description:
Natural Formation
Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens
Approx. 5.5" x 4" and 4" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This lot features two distinct geological specimens, showcasing the natural beauty of crystalline formations. The first is a classic hollow quartz geode with a textured dark matrix opening to reveal a cavity of sparkling white crystals. The second is an amethyst cluster specimen featuring light purple crystalline structures atop a layered agate and rock base. Together, these pieces provide a compelling study of mineral growth and make for excellent decorative display pieces or additions to a rock and mineral collection.
Total combined weight of 3.1 lbs as confirmed by digital scale measurement
One specimen features a distinct amethyst cluster with lavender-hued points and visible agate banding
Exterior bases include minor inventory markings in red and purple ink from previous cataloging
Largest specimen measures approximately 5.5 inches in length based on visual scale
Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.
